jobs.title: Director, Corporate Development
jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

We are looking for a Director of Corporate Development to help shape and execute our inorganic growth strategy. You will lead M&A and strategic partnership efforts end-to-end — from sourcing and due diligence through negotiation, deal execution, and post-close integration. This is a high-impact, cross-functional role that sits at the intersection of strategy, finance, and business operations. This role reports directly to the VP of Corporate Development and works closely with executive leadership across product, finance, and legal.

What You Will Be Doing

-
Conduct comprehensive market assessments to identify suitable acquisition targets. Evaluate industry trends that influence the company's growth strategy. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather valuable market insights.

-
Develop financial models to project future cash flows and revenue impacts for potential acquisitions. Analyze the historical financial performance of target companies to guide strategic decision-making.

-
Lead the entire M&A process, from sourcing potential deals to negotiating and closing transactions. Conduct thorough due diligence to identify risks and evaluate synergies.

-
Drive post-merger integration planning in coordination with functional stakeholders, ensuring deal value is captured

-
Prepare and present materials for executive and board-level audiences

What You Bring

-
6–10 years of experience in investment banking, venture capital, growth equity, or corporate development at a leading technology company. Successful track record of executing M&A transactions

-
Exceptional financial modeling and valuation skills; deep experience with negotiation and deal structuring

-
Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously in a dynamic environment

-
Strong executive presence with the ability to communicate complex analyses clearly and concisely

-
High degree of intellectual curiosity and business judgment

-
MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred

jobs.title: Financial Planning and Analysis Manager-(Renewals)
jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

About the Role:

We're looking for a Manager to own our renewal base analytics and bookings classification framework. This is a high-impact individual contributor role sitting within GTM FP&A, working at the intersection of finance, revenue operations, and go-to-market strategy. You'll bring deep Enterprise Software FP&A expertise to one of the company's most critical functions — renewal base health, multi-year forecasting, and bookings policy — shaping how we plan, compensate, and report on the business.

What You'll Do:

Renewal Base Ownership

-
Own and maintain the renewal base model, producing reliable multi-year forecasts that inform company-level planning

-
Set renewal base targets and quotas for annual planning cycles, partnering with Sales, RevOps, and Finance management to align on assumptions

-
Define renewal base inputs for compensation planning, ensuring quota-setting methodology is consistent and defensible

-
Serve as the primary point of escalation for renewal base discrepancies, investigating and resolving data or methodology issues raised by sales, CS, and finance stakeholders

Bookings Policy & Classification

-
Own the framework for how bookings are classified — new, expansion, or renewal — and ensure consistent application across the business

-
Define and maintain bookings policy, including what constitutes a genuine new workflow versus management of churned accounts or churned workflows

-
Partner with RevOps to operationalize policy decisions in CRM and reporting systems, and serve as the subject matter expert when edge cases arise

Enterprise FP&A Partnership

-
Serve as the GTM FP&A owner for renewal-driven revenue, integrating renewal base forecasts into broader company operating plans, long-range models, and board-level reporting

-
Partner with Finance management to translate renewal base performance into P&L implications — connecting ARR trends, net retention, and bookings mix to revenue recognition and growth narratives

-
Support the annual planning and reforecasting cycles with structured scenario analysis, bridging GTM assumptions to financial outcomes across the enterprise

Systems & Reporting Partnership

-
Work with the IT and Salesforce engineering teams. Convert the bookings policy and renewal base logic into system rules, workflows, and reports. You will serve as the business-side Subject Matter Expert (SME). In this role, you will define requirements. You will also ensure that the system operates according to the policy intentions.

What You Bring:

-
5–7 years of FP&A experience, with meaningful time spent in Enterprise Software or SaaS — you understand how recurring revenue businesses are modeled, planned, and reported at the company level

-
Deep knowledge with ARR/renewal mechanics, bookings definitions, and how they interact with quota and compensation design

-
Proven ability to build and maintain complex financial models, and to connect GTM metrics to enterprise-level financial planning (operating plan, long-range plan, board materials)

-
Experience supporting or owning a full annual planning cycle — from GTM target-setting through finance consolidation

-
Ability to work cross-functionally and influence without authority — you'll regularly align stakeholders across sales, finance, and ops

-
Clear communicator who can translate nuanced policy decisions into simple, actionable guidance for the field

-
High attention to detail and comfort operating in ambiguity, particularly when defining or adjudicating edge cases in policy

-
Experience working with IT or technical teams to translate business requirements into CRM reasoning, reports, or workflows

Nice to Have:

-
Experience with Salesforce, Clari, or similar CRM/forecasting tools

-
Prior exposure to compensation planning processes (OTE, quota-setting)

-
Background working closely with or embedded within a RevOps function

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Pricing and Packaging
jobs.description:

The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

We are seeking a Senior Program Manager, Pricing and Packaging to join the Product Finance team. This role will partner closely with the Product organization to bring new offerings to market. You'll work across functions and levels of leadership to make a real impact on how Elastic brings products to market.

What You Will Be Doing

As Elastic expands into increasingly complex offerings, the path from idea to launched monetized product requires heavy cross-functional coordination. You’ll be a key strategic partner to our Product organization, owning the operational end-to-end of Pricing and Packaging.

- Cross Functional Influence: Drive alignment across the stakeholders required to launch a pricing or packaging change, including FP&A, Revenue, Legal, IT, and Billing. Hold stakeholders accountable to timelines and decisions, translate priorities and requirements across functions, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks between product intent and commercial execution.

- Pricing and Packaging Knowledge: Demonstrate a proficient working knowledge of SaaS pricing models, packaging structures, and monetization levers, including consumption-based and usage-based models. Understand how decisions around tiering, bundling, metering, and discounting flow through the business from product design to revenue recognition.

- Process Architecture: Map and document the existing launch process to create a repeatable, scalable playbook. Make recommendations for process improvements that reduce time-to-market and improve coordination as Elastic's product portfolio grows in complexity. Process rigor here directly protects revenue by keeping launches on schedule and monetization logic intact.

- Accountability and Follow-Through: Maintain a clear, real-time view of open items, owners, dependencies, and approvals across every active launch. Develop and enforce rigorous processes for tracking progress and following up on action items. Identify friction points before they become blockers, and escalate accordingly.

What You Bring

The ideal candidate will have 10+ years of program or project management experience in the product organization of a SaaS or technology company with a track record of managing complex, cross-functional external product releases from start to finish. Experience working at the intersection of Product, Finance, Legal, and Systems teams is strongly preferred.

Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to diverse audiences, including technical, business, and executive stakeholders. The ideal candidate has a genuine curiosity about Elastic's products, helping them ask the right questions and advocate for the right process changes.

Elastic is looking for a Senior FP&A Analyst to join our India finance team. You will support financial planning, reporting, and analysis for our global finance function — and help make our finance processes faster and smarter using AI tools. This is a great opportunity for someone who is curious, enjoys solving problems, and wants to do more than just run reports.

-
Financial Partnership — Act as a trusted finance partner to business and functional leaders, providing timely reporting, dashboards, and visibility into operational spend. Serve as the primary point of contact for financial analytics and ad-hoc requests.

-
Reporting & Analysis — Deliver management reporting packages, business scorecards, and financial models for senior leadership . Build and maintain dashboards using Tableau, Sigma, or similar tools — with a focus on real-time reporting.

-
Forecasting & Budgeting — Support rolling forecasts, annual budgeting, and monthly budget vs. actual analysis using Pigment. Monitor KPIs, highlight trends, and deliver clear variance commentary.

-
Experience — 5–8 years in a finance function with exposure to business transformation, process re-engineering, or finance automation. CA / MBA / CMA preferred.

-
AI & Automation Fluency — Hands-on experience using AI tools (Copilot, Claude, Gemini, or similar) in a finance workflow — an active user, not just someone aware of the tools. Experience with Pigment, Adaptive, or NetSuite is a strong plus.

Transformation Mindset — Spots manual, repetitive processes and drives smarter alternatives. Comfortable proposing new tools and building the case for change.

-
Collaboration & Teaching — Works cross-functionally, shares knowledge, and coaches peers on automation and new tools. Makes the team around them better.

Communication — Simplifies financial complexity for non-finance stakeholders at all levels. Comfortable working across global teams and time zones.

You will lead initiatives to optimize our quote-to-cash (Q2C) and revenue recognition architecture as we scale private offers and co-sell motions through AWS, GCP, and Azure Marketplaces .

What You Will Be Doing

-

1. Marketplace Financial System Architecture

-
Architecture & Scalability: Partner with IT and Product Engineering to design and implement scalable workflows that bridge the gap between hyperscaler portals and core finance systems (e.g., NetSuite, Salesforce, Zuora

-
Automate workflows: Design and implement automated finance workflows to handle complex marketplace transactions, including Private Offers (CPPO/MPPO) and custom metering.

-
Integrate systems: Partner with IT to seamlessly connect Hyperscaler APIs and marketplace management platforms (e.g. Tackle.io ) with core finance systems

-
Build data pipelines: Own the financial data model for marketplace transactions, ensuring reliable ingestion of raw billing and disbursement data into reporting warehouses.

2. Revenue Recognition & Financial Operations

-
Manage compliance: Define financial process standards for deferred revenue, gross-vs-net revenue accounting, and ASC 606 compliance specific to cloud marketplace deductions and listing fees.

-
Streamline reconciliations: Build scalable transaction-level reconciliation models to match hyperscaler disbursements and remittance advices against internal sales contracts.

-
Financial Integrity: Maintain transaction accuracy, ensure marketplace listing fees are accurately tracked, and handle dense, unstructured third-party reseller data

3. Cross-Functional Program Management

-
Business Model Alignment: Partner with Finance, Product and Partner Operations teams to prepare finance and accounting operations for newly introduced marketplace product offerings

-
Lead change management: Direct User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and author Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for the finance and accounting teams when launching new marketplace capabilities.

What You Bring

- Core Finance: 8–10+ years of progressive experience in accounting operations, financial systems, or tech-sector management consulting.

-
Marketplace Exposure: 5+ years of direct experience managing the financial operations, billing infrastructure, or billing reconciliation of apps sold through AWS, GCP, or Azure Marketplaces .

-
Transformation Track Record: Proven experience leading large-scale software integrations or Q2C transformation cycles in a B2B SaaS or enterprise tech environment.

-
Marketplace Tools: Deep familiarity with cloud partner portals (AWS, GCP, Azure) and marketplace monetization middleware (e.g., Tackle.io ).

-
ERP & Revenue Systems: Advanced knowledge of enterprise ERP systems and specialized revenue recognition systems (e.g., Zuora RevPro).

-
Data Fluency: Solid proficiency utilizing SQL or Business Intelligence tools to dissect, clear, and transform unstructured billing data
